title: Enable tenant-scoped audit traces and KMS region pinning for Private deployments
author: Maya Chen
description:
Motivation: Private deployments currently surface audit logs that are global to the control plane. For compliance customers we need tenant-scoped audit traces (so a customer's audit trail cannot be mixed with another tenant's) and a deterministic way to pin KMS operations to a single region/CMK when customers request data residency.

This PR implements: 1) tenant-scoped audit traces at ingestion and storage layers, 2) RBAC v2 additions (kms-admin and audit-reader roles) and tighter policy validation, 3) a new installer flag --kms-region-pin (and validation) for Private/VPC installs to lock KMS usage to a region, and 4) docs and a migration guide for existing Private installations.

Changes in this PR are backwards-compatible by default: if --kms-region-pin is not set, behavior is unchanged. RBAC policy schema changes use additive roles; existing policies remain valid but admins are encouraged to grant audit-reader/kms-admin where appropriate. Migration path included.

Checklist: - [x] Add tenant_id propagation through gateway and control plane audit path - [x] Schema & storage change for audit entries (indexing by tenant) - [x] New RBAC role templates and policy validator update - [x] Installer flag + validation + e2e for region pinning - [x] Docs: private-installer README, RBAC migration guide, compliance FAQ - [x] CI: unit + integration + updated e2e; flaky test rerun fixed

Linear/Tracking: ENG-1548 (audit multi-tenant), ENG-1569 (kms region pin). Related support: SUP-5210.

Notes for reviewers: pay attention to the audit storage migration (lightweight backfill implemented in control plane that reindexes on first read) and the installer-time validation that rejects mismatched KMS regions. The change intentionally separates KMS config from general region config to prevent accidental cross-region key usage.

release_notes: Private deployments: tenant-scoped audit traces (audit entries are now indexed by tenant_id). New RBAC roles: 'audit-reader' (read-only audit access) and 'kms-admin' (KMS configuration and rotate). Installer: new --kms-region-pin flag to enforce KMS usage in a single region for data residency compliance. Migration: lightweight on-read audit reindexing with console visibility. See docs for migration steps and impact.
